levels.name: Sublime Salutations
levels.description: Within 3s after using Artistic Ingenuity, Kaveh's Dendro RES and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

levels.name: Grace of Royal Roads
levels.description: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during Painted Dome.

levels.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
levels.description: Increases the Level of Painted Dome by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Feast of Apadana
levels.description: Dendro Cores created from Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

levels.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
levels.description: Increases the Level of Artistic Ingenuity by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
levels.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during Painted Dome, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as AoE Dendro DMG and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
